infrastructure_nodes_capacity_check.name: infrastructure_nodes_capacity_check
infrastructure_nodes_capacity_check.value:
("infrastructure_nodes"."capacity_cpu_milli" is null or "infrastructure_nodes"."capacity_cpu_milli" > 0)
        and ("infrastructure_nodes"."capacity_memory_bytes" is null or "infrastructure_nodes"."capacity_memory_bytes" > 0)
        and ("infrastructure_nodes"."capacity_disk_bytes" is null or "infrastructure_nodes"."capacity_disk_bytes" > 0)

infrastructure_nodes_utilization_check.name: infrastructure_nodes_utilization_check
infrastructure_nodes_utilization_check.value:
("infrastructure_nodes"."cpu_usage_basis_points" is null or "infrastructure_nodes"."cpu_usage_basis_points" between 0 and 10000)
        and ("infrastructure_nodes"."memory_used_bytes" is null or "infrastructure_nodes"."memory_used_bytes" >= 0)
        and ("infrastructure_nodes"."disk_used_bytes" is null or "infrastructure_nodes"."disk_used_bytes" >= 0)
        and ("infrastructure_nodes"."disk_usage_basis_points" is null or "infrastructure_nodes"."disk_usage_basis_points" between 0 and 10000)
